message.content: On September 16th, WolfgangSchulz proposed incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. He shared that he felt this could really boost their jazz fusion skills, making their sessions more fun and creative. LiHua enthusiastically agreed, suggesting that improvisation would challenge them and help them grow as musicians. Yuriko Yamamoto was also excited about the prospect, believing it would allow them to showcase different parts of their musical abilities. WolfgangSchulz further suggested going with the flow, emphasizing that the practice should be spontaneous and enjoyable, with everyone contributing to the jam session. LiHua agreed and proposed starting with a specific song or allowing the improvisation to develop naturally. The team decided to incorporate improvisational solos into their regular Sunday night practices.
